rule: Overture transportation segments of subtype road and class motorway, trunk, primary, secondary, tertiary, unclassified, residential, living_street, service, pedestrian; Douglas-Peucker 2 m; quantised to 1/100000 degree; each in the level-11 cell of its bbox middle (cells of 180 / 2^11 degrees, y from 90 S); the middle must be in the build cell
credit: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), via Overture Maps Foundation transportation theme
lines_format: lines: [class index, name index or -1, x0, y0, dx1, dy1, ...] in 1/q degree (x lon, y lat; deltas after the first point)
